summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-N3 admits no external crate. academic-freshness links academic-domain, academic-knowledge-state, serde and thiserror as product edges, and academic-capture, academic-consent, academic-lecture-document, academic-model-run, academic-policy, academic-repository, academic-repository-analysis, academic-repository-classification, academic-repository-correlation, academic-transcription, academic-untrusted-content, tempfile, trybuild and uuid as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package. Nothing links into a product binary that was not already there: the two workspace product edges are path packages this repository already builds, and serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt. Build-time-only additions are zero -- there is no build script, no proc macro beyond serde's and thiserror's, and no code generator.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-freshness is the P2-N3 boundary: section 13.3's six freshness bands, the seven inputs that produce one and their trace, the per-evidence-kind persistence the design document orders, the single-hop spillover cited on a section 7.2 edge and weighted strictly below direct use, the user's own recall statement and the three contrary events, and the versioned UNCALIBRATED_PRIOR_V1 with the calibration GATE-38-024 leaves open. It is a separate package from academic-knowledge-state because the separation section 1's fifth invariant demands is then a graph fact rather than a rule: this crate has no name for a mastery level, so a decay that took one would first have to import it. It is a separate package from academic-domain because it reads P2-N2's EligibleEvidence, which academic-domain sits below and cannot depend on without a cycle.

no_second_ladder_note: Section 13.3's FreshnessBand was declared by P2-C1 in academic-domain and this task declares no second enumeration: what it adds is BANDS, the same six in the order section 13.3's own sentence names them, and rank, band_token and step_down, each a total match with no wildcard arm, so a seventh band is a compile error here rather than a value some list quietly fails to mention. ClaimObject::Freshness was already the wire shape of a claim about a band, so a recall statement is verified against one rather than against a second vocabulary. The twenty section 7.2 predicates were fixed by P2-C1's predicate registry and the spillover allowlist is four of those by name, compared against PredicateName::ALL in both directions. Section 13.2's eight evidence rows and section 13.4's four eligibility checks were fixed by P2-N2, and this crate dates an EligibleEvidence rather than declaring a second admissibility rule. Section 13.1's mastery ladder was fixed by P2-N2 and this crate does not name it at all.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: FreshnessBand, ClaimObject, ConfidencePermille, EntityId, EvidenceId, ScopeId, TimestampMillis, Actor, Claim, EpistemicStatus, EvidenceItem, DomainError and predicates::PredicateName. The six bands are that crate's and are measured against it rather than copied beside it. ADR-003's Claim::validate_for_actor is what makes RecallStatement user-only: every automatic actor variant fails that matrix when it attempts the USER_EXPLICIT/USER_CONFIRMED pairing, and so does the user's own actor on a claim carrying a model's authority. PredicateName is section 7.2's twenty edges, four of which license a spillover.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-knowledge-state: EligibleEvidence, EvidenceKind and FreshnessInput. Section 13.3's first input is the last strong evidence, and the evidence it means is the evidence that passed section 13.4's four checks -- so a DatedEvidence wraps an EligibleEvidence and there is no other constructor, which is P2-N2's `ineligible evidence has no value of the type the projection accepts` applied to the other axis. FreshnessInput is that crate's own two-field carrier and is the only value this crate hands back to it. What this edge does NOT bring is the point: it re-exports LADDER, rung, level_token, AutomaticLevel and MasteryProjection, this crate imports none of them, and the_freshness_crate_cannot_name_a_mastery compares the whole set of its use items, reached paths and macros against pinned inventories in both directions.

dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-capture: P2-L2's begin, its journal and its preflight readings, reached through P2-N2's fixture module, so the manifest a document is built over is the file the real capture surface wrote.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-consent: P2-L2's consent ledger, capture request and permission scope, because a capture that is not permitted writes no journal and the fixture must pass the same gate a real one does.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-lecture-document: LectureDocument and NodeId, so section 13.2's first row -- the exposure side of section 13.3's persistence sentence -- is a node of a document P2-L4 produced rather than a string this suite invented.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-model-run: CalibrationRegistry and its dataset types, which P2-L3's confidence interpretation requires before a segment exists.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-policy: ContentDigest, for the analysis policy hash a P2-R1 snapshot request carries.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository: P2-R1's capture_local and SnapshotRequest, reached through P2-N2's fixture module.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-analysis: P2-R2's EvidenceLadder and Finding, reached through the same module.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-classification: P2-R4's ConceptStance, which P2-N2's fixture module reads to produce section 13.2's fourth and seventh rows.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-correlation: P2-R3's correlate, the only route from findings to the relation edges P2-R4 reads.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-transcription: P2-L3's run, its provider contract and its transcript lineage, so a document node maps a segment of a real transcript.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-untrusted-content: SourceIndex, which P2-R1's capture_local returns and P2-R2's AnalysisInput::of checks every unit against.
dev_workspace_dependencies.tempfile: The directory a P2-L2 journal is written to. It is a dev edge only; no product file of this crate names it or any other filesystem type.
dev_workspace_dependencies.trybuild: The compile-fail suite. Section 13.3's limits are types, and the nine cases under crates/freshness/tests/compile_fail assert that each refusal is a program that does not compile with a committed diagnostic. The cases live in this package rather than in academic-scenario's suite for the reason P2-N2 gives: this crate reaches academic-knowledge-state, which reaches academic-ledger, and scenario_crate_has_no_writer_dependency refuses academic-scenario that crate through a dev edge as much as a product one.
dev_workspace_dependencies.uuid: Deterministic UUIDv7-shaped fixture identities. Every identifier in the suite is a SHA-256 of the fixture's own name with the version and variant nibbles set, so no identity is a function of a clock.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-freshness is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns section 13.3's freshness axis and, for each rule, the value that does not exist rather than the check somebody has to remember to run: the crate has no name for a MasteryLevel, so decay takes an elapsed span and a persistence window because those are the only things it can take, and the one value it hands back to P2-N2 is a FreshnessInput carrying a band and a confidence and no third field; DatedEvidence wraps an EligibleEvidence and has no other constructor, so evidence that failed section 13.4's four checks cannot freshen a concept it cannot promote; NeighborUse is built from a neighbour's own dated evidence and from no band, projection or contribution, so a second hop needs evidence the second concept does not have, and it refuses a dated item linked to any concept other than the neighbour, which is the two-hop route that survives every other limit; CitedEdge has one constructor refusing an uncited edge, a self-edge and any predicate outside four of section 7.2's twenty; RecallStatement's one constructor runs ADR-003's actor matrix, so a model run cannot say on the user's behalf that they still remember something; and PersonalizationSpeed has no Default and no constant of its type, so GATE-38-024's personalization half is unreachable without a configuration decision. Its dependency set is minimal and the edges it does not have are the point: no academic-store, so no band can reach the canonical writer and no migration is added; no academic-worker and no academic-egress-boundary, so nothing in its closure can launch a process or stage a payload.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, opens no file, reads no clock, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It spells no std::fs, std::net, std::process, std::env or std::time name at all: every instant arrives as a TimestampMillis argument named as_of. the_freshness_crate_cannot_name_a_mastery and no_clock_socket_or_file_reaches_this_crate in crates/freshness/tests/freshness_scans.rs compare the whole set of its 39 use items, the whole set of the 4 two-segment paths it reaches through a crate root, the whole set of the 2 macros it invokes and the 8 modules lib.rs re-exports from against pinned inventories in both directions, and run a whole-identifier pass for fifteen filesystem, clock, process and transport constructs over every product file. Eight injections that spell none of the forbidden tokens were each observed failing a scan: a fully-qualified academic_knowledge_state::KnowledgeStateAssertion reach with no use item and no listed mastery name, the same reach with the path split by whitespace, an aliased MasteryFacet import hidden inside a function body, an include_str! reading another file, a Default implementation shipping a personalization speed, a public &mut self setter on the projection, a changed decay arm under its whole-text pin, and the neighbour-evidence guard removed under its pin. Its link closure holds nothing that can open a socket beyond libc, which reaches it through academic-policy by way of academic-knowledge-state. Every document, capture, transcript, snapshot, stance, claim and assertion in its test tree is synthetic and built in process; no real lecture or repository is read and no network call is made.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-freshness links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt; tempfile, trybuild and uuid are already-admitted dev dependencies of other workspace packages. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
